summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.82/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.82 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 9, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 6¢ lower than a month ago, and 84¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.56) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.15).
